connections.notes: R4 is a river waypoint positioned at the water's edge adjacent to room 8E (Burial Platform). The river runs right alongside 8E, and R4 marks the crossing point at that bank.

8W (River Ledge) is on the western side of the same room complex as 8E. R4 as a river waypoint connects to the river-adjacent areas, and 8W is named River Ledge indicating it borders the water at or near this crossing point.
R3 (North River Passage) is the next river waypoint upstream/north along the river from R4. The river channel visibly connects these two waypoints with continuous water flow.
R5 (River exit at cliff) is the next river waypoint downstream/south from R4. The river channel flows continuously from R4 southward to R5.
Room 5 (Collapsed Burial Chamber) appears to border the river on its eastern side near R4's position, providing river access at this crossing point.

not_connected.reason: Room 13 (The Riven Hall) is located well to the northwest of R4, separated by multiple walls and rooms with no direct passage or river connection.
Room 15 (Penultimate Crypt) is in the far northeast of the map, separated from R4 by walls and other rooms with no direct connection visible.
Room 4 (Great Northern Hall) is a large central room well to the west and south of R4, separated by walls and intervening rooms with no direct passage.
Room 4A (Great Bronze Doors) is adjacent to room 4 in the central area, far from R4 with no visible passage or river connection.
Room 6 (Sealed Eastern Door) is south of the central area, separated from R4 by walls and other spaces with no direct connection visible.
R1 (North-West River Crossing) is on the far northwest section of the river, not directly connected to R4 — other river waypoints (R2, R3) lie between them along the watercourse.
R2 (North River Crossing) is upstream along the river but separated from R4 by R3; the river does not flow directly from R2 to R4 without passing through R3.
